description: Utility class for handling URLs and resource loading within the Apache OFBiz framework, including methods to load resources from classpath, filesystem, and environment variables.

classes.name: UtilURL
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for URL and resource management in OFBiz.

methods.name: fromClass
methods.description: Generates a URL for a properties file associated with a given class.

methods.name: fromResource
methods.description: Loads a resource as URL by resource name, with optional class loader.

methods.name: fromFilename
methods.description: Creates a URL from a filename if it exists.

methods.name: fromUrlString
methods.description: Converts a URL string into a URL object.

methods.name: fromOfbizHomePath
methods.description: Builds a URL based on the OFBIZ_HOME environment property.

methods.name: getOfbizHomeRelativeLocation
methods.description: Returns the relative path of a URL with respect to OFBIZ_HOME.
